title: Transcribe a Handwritten Answer
notes: One photo per answer. The AI model transcribes it word for word and does not correct the student's content. Words it cannot read are written as [?]. legibility is unclear when confidence is below 0.8 or any [?] is present. The student confirms or corrects the text before it is graded.

response.text: Binary search needs a sorted list. It checks the middle element and compares it to the [?]. Then it throws away half of the list and repeats.
